Name: Twenty One Pilots Clancy Mask
Author: rrafff
Description:
[center]This mod adds a Clancy Mask from Twenty One Pilots for sale in the Hat Mouse.
Available for sale in the Hat Mouse.

✨⊬✨

The Clancy Mask does not replace any existing vanilla hats.

Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI.

✨ғ̶ᴘ̶ᴇ̶ ✨

Special thanks to @rokugin and @spiderbuttons in the SV Discord server modding channel for
helping me create this, as it's my first mod.[/center]
